notes:
**The Coach told a trader he was losing on a sample where he was up.** "Even a 60% win rate loses money at this ratio" is arithmetic, and it was false wherever the card fired below 1.5 - which is most of its range. Six wins of Rs 1,000 against four losses of Rs 1,400 is a net of PLUS Rs 400, and the coach printed a red card saying otherwise. It works out the real break-even win rate for your actual ratio now.

**The behaviour check was blaming your rule for the test.** When a generated test case carried fewer candles than your rule needs, the sandbox refused to run it - and that was recorded as "the rule decided to do nothing". A rule needing 21 candles, tested on 8, failed every case it should have passed; and if all its cases were short the verdict read "this rule gave the same answer to every case", about code that never ran once.

**On Dhan the screener's day-change column could never work.** The quote parser was reading the OHLC block and dropping the closing price, so every "change from yesterday" was blank and "Opened up" matched nothing - reported as a fact about the market rather than about the feed.

**"NIFTY 50 universe" was 48 names.** TATAMOTORS and LTIM are not in the symbol table and were dropped in silence. The screen says what it actually scanned now, and names what it could not find.

**The 4-year weekly chart was showing 14 months.** The daily cache served whatever was fetched first, and app startup pins about 14 months before any screen opens.

**An alert set in the evening forgot which side the price was on** - the overnight-gap case the feature exists for.
